items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: And I saw some time back, and Bebe Ridley, he used to use that stick too.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about the Sam Morgan band. Whose idea was it, that slapstick of ever using that? Did he get that from the drummer or something? Or how did he happen to start on that?

Well, at that time the drummers used to use slapsticks in the band. And Sam was, had been very sick and I guess that was something he thought would, you could bring Newt to the band, you understand? Maybe not as far as I missed the story. Yeah, no, when the band was playing he used to use that stick. Yeah. And I saw some time back, and Bebe Ridley, he used to use that stick too. Oh, he did? Yeah, when he was playing drums. I know he was playing trombone at that time. Well, Sam used that stick a long time, I'm…
Kid Thomas uses that quite a bit nowadays too. Who? Kid Thomas still has a slapstick. Oh yeah. He used it. Manuel Paul sometimes too.
